channel.title: Paksh: Health
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.description: A study found that approximately one in four men serving in the U.S. Army may have low testosterone levels. The findings indicate a significant portion of the military personnel could be affected by this condition. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Ultra-processed foods not linked to colorectal cancer, study finds
item.description: A large study has found no link between the consumption of ultra-processed foods and an increased risk of colorectal cancer. The findings contradict some previous research that suggested a connection between these foods and certain cancers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
